course_name_original: Aufbaumodul Modellbasierte Entscheidungsunterstützung, Business Intelligence & Analytics
course_name_en: Advanced Module Model-based Decision Support, Business Intelligence & Analytics
prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules for Practical Informatics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge and skills in the field of Model-based Decision Support, Business Intelligence & Analytics.
Students know the theoretical foundations of Model-based Decision Support, Business Intelligence & Analytics as well as selected applications.
Students are able to apply methods from business informatics.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Types of decision problems, decision support systems
Mathematical-statistical models and methods of Knowledge Discovery in Databases
Models and methods of Operations Research
Models and methods of Artificial Intelligence and Soft Computing

assessment_methods.method: Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program. To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises must be achieved.
